dedupe_keys.name: torino urban weather dataset and epw files for building energy simulation 2014 2023

description: This dataset turns ten years of readings from seven Arpa Piemonte weather stations in and around Torino into hourly weather files for building energy simulation. The stations measure air temperature, humidity, wind speed and direction, pressure and solar radiation; the authors cleaned and merged the records in Python, split global radiation into direct and diffuse parts, filled gaps, built a typical meteorological year per station to ISO 15927-4, and wrote EnergyPlus weather files. The Zenodo release lists seven typical-year EPW files, one per station, from central urban sites such as Giardini Reali and Via della Consolata to the Caselle airport. Coverage: the Torino metropolitan area. Access: free download from Zenodo. Licence: CC BY 4.0. Caveats: gap filling and radiation splitting are modelled, not measured; station siting differs, which is the point for urban heat contrasts but must be kept in mind. Simulation uses are urban versus rural comparisons of building heating and cooling demand and overheating risk, and urban heat island studies in one city. Related records: the IEA EBC Annex 80 weather files and EnergyPlus.
